name: volatility_contraction_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP programs temporarily pause directional orders during data assimilation windows — post-news absorption, pre-lunch lulls, pre-event waits — creating 3-5 minute stretches where every 5-second bar has below-average range and volume, pushing the 60-second ATR below the 20th percentile of its 10-minute rolling distribution. When this equilibrium cracks, market makers adjusting delta hedges and trapped short-side participants covering wrong-way positions create a concentrated burst of flow visible as a single 5-second bar with range > 1.5x recent ATR and volume > 1.8x 5-minute average. At 5-second resolution we enter exactly that expansion bar rather than waiting for a full 1-minute confirmation, capturing the first 10-20 NIFTY spot points of the breakout leg. VWAP direction filters out mid-session noise.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-minute sustained ATR squeeze below 20th percentile followed by expansion bar with range > 1.5x ATR and volume > 1.8x average
